scientific_question: MECHANISM_SCALE_GENERALIZATION: does the frozen A0C/A0E2 causal tangent mechanism (FD/B/BH_fixed/C ladder) replicate a second time when model scale grows 26.68M -> ~100M (20.2x anchor) with training data / optimizer / clipping / tokenizer / code / response protocol held fixed?
scale_only_principle: Only hidden_size and num_hidden_layers change vs the v07 anchor config (heads/kv chosen to preserve head_dim=64 and 2:1 GQA ratio); everything else (tokenizer, position encoding, normalization, activation, attention implementation, loss, dataset D0, seq len, AdamW family and hyperparameters, clip=1.0, bf16 semantics, perturbation/q/CRN/FD/tangent definitions) is identical to G1a and the anchor.

model.intermediate_size_rule: MiniMindConfig default ceil(hidden*pi/64)*64 = ceil(768*pi/64)*64 = 38*64 = 2432 (same frozen formula as anchor and G1a; NOT hand-picked)
model.selection_reason: mandate-preferred structure hidden=768/layers=13/heads=12/kv=6 is legal in the frozen implementation (head_dim=64, 2:1 GQA) and measured 100,784,000 unique params inside the 95M-110M window; frozen immediately per mandate without trying any other size; intermediate follows the frozen default formula
model.param_count_note: count measured by static CPU instantiation of the frozen MiniMindConfig BEFORE any training/response result (unique=100,784,000; state_dict elements=100,784,000 with tied embeddings); runner asserts this count at train time

training.seed_note: same train seeds as G1a: paired-scale design (5M bank uses 2030-2037, G1a/G1b use 2042-2044); NOT a new independent seed replication
training.seed_conflict_check: 2042-2044 unused by v07 bank (2030-2037), A0G (2038-2041), or any registered experiment
training.dataset: outputs/e3_confirmatory/v07/e3c_subset.jsonl (D0, same 4096-line subset as v07 and G1a)
training.lr_schedule: minimind trainer_utils.get_lr cosine (same as anchor and G1a)
training.optimizer: torch.optim.AdamW default family: betas=(0.9,0.999), eps=1e-8, weight_decay=0.01
training.train_batch_seed_rule: train_seed + 1704 (same frozen derivation rule as v07 and G1a)
training.note: identical 128-optimizer-step frozen schedule as G1a: same global batch (8 seq), same tokens/step (1024), same total token budget; training stops at LATE step 102; LR schedule remains defined over total_micro_steps=256
training.device_microbatch_adjustment_policy: if OOM: device microbatch may drop (e.g. 4->2) with accumulation increased (2->4) keeping global batch/tokens identical; the adjustment must be recorded here and in CHANGE_LOG before any formal run
training.checkpoint_contents: model state (original dtype), AdamW m/v/step, scaler state, full RNG state (python/numpy/torch cpu/torch cuda), global optimizer step, LR/scheduler context via metadata, batch-stream reconstruction metadata (train_batch_seed, partition sha256), config + hashes

q_construction.rule: identical to v07 E3C and G1a: per state, probe batch = all 32 partition probe_indices in one batch, probe loss backward, q = g_probe / ||g_probe|| (global L2), probe/eval permanently excluded from trajectory

response_protocol_inheritance.pulse: post-unscale / pre-clip, first optimizer step only, +/-epsilon*q
response_protocol_inheritance.epsilon_rule: epsilon = 0.25 * sigma_q, sigma_q = std(ddof=1) of s over 16 E1 streams (frozen v07 rule, unchanged)
response_protocol_inheritance.crn: baseline/plus/minus share identical Z_t, batch manifest, RNG stream, LR path; only +/-epsilon*q differs
response_protocol_inheritance.rho0_noop_check: sign=+1 epsilon=0.0 must bit-match baseline (same as v07/G1a)
response_protocol_inheritance.future_lr: set_native_micro_lr along the same 256-micro-step cosine axis
response_protocol_inheritance.horizons_note: frozen tangent runners internally step through every optimizer step 1..max(H); recorded predictions at H in {1,2,4,8} are a byproduct - official analysis grid is exactly {1,4,8}; FD branches are run with horizons {1,4,8} only
response_protocol_inheritance.hvp: math-SDPA reverse-over-reverse surrogate (native flash has no double backward) - same frozen mixed-backend caveat as A0C/A0E2/G1a
response_protocol_inheritance.model_A: not part of G1b main comparison

streams.stream_seed_rule: two_level_seed(base, train_seed, state_step, stream_id) then batch_seed=derive_stream_seed(stream_seed, 404) - identical derivation rule to v07/G1a with G1b-specific bases (identity separation across experiments while keeping the paired-scale rule comparable)
streams.ordering_rule: all 36 future-stream manifests are generated and written (future_stream_manifest.json) BEFORE any E2 response branch is executed

main_matrix.note: B/C tangent replay additionally produces H=2 byproduct predictions (frozen runner internal grid); these never enter official statistics

mechanism_subset.identity_requirement: at H=1, B = BH_fixed = C within numerical tolerance (structural identity check)

gains.no_sign_presupposition: gains are reported signed per cell and pooled; no requirement that every cell be positive

checks: optimizer state dims/names match the 100M model
q strictly same names/shapes as parameters
FD +/- branches CRN-identical (batch manifest hash, LR path, observations of baseline branches)
H=1 analytic B vs FD consistency at registered epsilon
B/C shadow baseline hash equality at H=8
no unexpected optimizer steps (optimizer step counter audit)
smoke_gate.policy: implementation bugs may be fixed and re-smoked with a change log; any scientific-definition problem => CONTRACT_INCOMPATIBLE, stop and report; OOM remedies limited to config device_microbatch_adjustment_policy

extra_summary: C beats B count / ties / losses at H>1
statistics.relative_error_median: median per-cell relative error reported alongside mean
statistics.scale_comparison: 5M anchor (v07 A0C/A0E2 frozen records) vs G1a 26M frozen summary vs G1b 100M: C pooled R2/MAE/mean+median rel err, B mean rel err, H8 B/C err, mean paired improvement, clip activation rates, preclip norms, gain_curvature/gain_clip; reported as scale trend, NOT a strict paired statistical test

recorded: future first-step clip rate (36 baseline streams)
future all-step clip rate (step_trace clip_active over future micro steps)
clipping_regime_diagnostics.usage: front-line observation for the planned G3 clipping intervention; NO empirical law may be fitted across the three scale points and the cause of any gain change is NOT determined

verdict_thresholds_frozen.analysis_grid: 9 states x H in {1,4,8} = 27 rows; H=1 rows are structural ties (B==C) and are excluded from paired win/loss counts but included in pooled R2/MAE

STRONG_SCALE_REPLICATION.condition_1: C pooled R2 over the 27 official rows >= 0.90
STRONG_SCALE_REPLICATION.condition_2: among the 18 H>1 rows (H in {4,8}), at least 80% (>=15 of 18) have err_C < err_B; tie defined as |err_C - err_B| <= 1e-12
STRONG_SCALE_REPLICATION.condition_3: H=8 (9 rows): paired mean err_C < mean err_B AND C R2 at H=8 >= 0.50 AND corr at H=8 > 0
STRONG_SCALE_REPLICATION.condition_4: at least 2 of 3 seeds have mean(err_B - err_C) > 0 over that seed's H>1 rows (6 rows per seed)

verdict_thresholds_frozen.PARTIAL_SCALE_REPLICATION: pooled H>1 mean relative error of C < that of B, but not all STRONG conditions hold (including heterogeneous seeds/stages)
verdict_thresholds_frozen.NO_SCALE_REPLICATION: C is not overall better than B, or C lost predictive validity vs FD
verdict_thresholds_frozen.RESOURCE_LIMIT: scientific experiment incomplete because the 100M full tangent is not executable on available hardware (with the allowed OOM remedies exhausted and fully documented)
verdict_thresholds_frozen.note: thresholds frozen here before any result is opened and will not be changed; same four conditions as G1a

dynamics_context.usage: context/explanation only; states may NOT be filtered post hoc using these variables

resource_rules.gpu: any currently available GPU; record sharing; never kill other workloads; not a wall-clock benchmark
allowed_under_oom: gradient checkpointing only if mathematically identical
smaller device microbatch with matching accumulation to keep global batch/tokens fixed
forbidden: changing seq len / global batch / clip / optimizer / precision semantics / horizons
resource_rules.resource_limit_policy: if 100M full tangent is infeasible on available hardware, emit RESOURCE_LIMIT with full diagnostics and memory numbers; do NOT silently downscale (e.g. do not pretend a 64M run is G1b)
